extraction.Name: Mary Brave Heart—Nee Red Hair
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 320 acre allotment, when she was advised that it was at the Indian Agency Office for her; but that she was advised that, if she did not accept it, it would be taxed, and finally be sold for taxes, so she took it
extraction.Buyer: John Scott, of the Gordon National Bank, Gordon, Nebraska, for $2500.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she kept the taxes paid up on her allotment until she sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: both she and her husband work at common labor whenever they can get it; and that is the only source of income they have
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has three children to support, one child has good health, the other two poor health; husband has poor health, most especially being bothered with his sight; she considers that she received a very poor price for her allotment; has never received any help from the County, State or the United States Government; affidavit subscribed and sworn to November 26, 1928
